history.summary: This is The Arcady at Boon Keng (freehold, D12, 460m to NE9), a 3BR compact at $1.98M / $2,592 psf. The freehold tenure and MRT-doorstep location are attractive, but a 764 sqft 'compact' 3BR at near-$2,600 psf is full new-launch pricing with the appreciation already priced in.
history.rating_rationale: The Arcady is a quality 172-unit freehold project right at Boon Keng MRT (460m) and 1km to Hong Wen — strong fundamentals. But $2,592 psf is at the top of the D12 new-launch range, and a 764 sqft compact 3BR is small for the bracket (yield/livability trade-off). No resale track record (new project). At $1.98M the ticket is liquid and freehold protects long-term value, so it balances to Neutral rather than a clear buy.
red_flags: $2,592 psf is full new-launch pricing — little appreciation margin left
764 sqft for a '3BR' is compact, limiting family-buyer appeal at resale

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Boon Keng is a solid rental micro-market (close to CBD, Novena, NE line); a compact 3BR rents well to small families and sharers, yield around market-typical given the high entry PSF.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Freehold city-fringe near MRT has durable appreciation potential, but buying at ~$2,600 psf new-launch level means much of the near-term upside is already captured.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: RCR/D12 freehold near-MRT prior, discounted for high new-launch entry PSF; The Arcady has no resale history
